definitions.explanation: The amount of medicine or substance to be taken or administered at one time or over a period. Commonly seen on medicine packaging and in medical instructions.

examples.japanese: {用量|ようりょう}を{守|まも}ってください。
{一日|いちにち}の{用量|ようりょう}は{三錠|さんじょう}です。
examples.english: The daily dosage is three tablets.

examples.japanese: {用法|ようほう}・{用量|ようりょう}をよく{読|よ}んでから{服用|ふくよう}してください。
examples.english: Please read the usage and dosage instructions carefully before taking the medicine.

notes:
{用量|ようりょう} is almost always used in medical and pharmaceutical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {用法|ようほう}・{用量|ようりょう} — usage and dosage (standard phrase on medicine labels)
- {一日|いちにち}の{用量|ようりょう} — daily dose
- {用量|ようりょう}を{守|まも}る — to follow the dosage
- {最大|さいだい}{用量|ようりょう} — maximum dose

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {容量|ようりょう} — capacity, volume (of a container; same reading but different kanji)
- {用量|ようりょう} — dosage (specific to medicine)

The pair {用法|ようほう}・{用量|ようりょう} appears on virtually all medicine packaging in Japan.
